events.title: DroneArt Show: Harry Potter in Seattle
events.cost: General admission starting at $47.12 for ages 12 and older; $31.92 for ages 3–11; free for ages 2 and younger
events.loc: Marymoor Park , 6046 W. Lake Sammamish Pkwy. N.E., Redmond
events.desc: Watch in awe as 1,200 synchronized drones light up the night sky, recreating iconic moments from the magical realm of Harry Potter. During the show, a live electric violinist will play the soundtrack. Food and drinks will be on offer before the show — get there early!

events.title: Aire Craft Festival
events.loc: Issaquah Community Center , 301 Rainier Blvd. S., Issaquah
events.desc: What do artists, pilots and circus performers have in common? They’ll all be at the inaugural Aire Craft Festival this weekend! The street arts festival will have flying trapeze performances, mural painting, flight demos and more. Plus, there will be tacos, wood-fired pizza and ice cream from local food trucks.

events.title: Waba Korea Expo & Festival
events.desc: K-pop has taken over my playlist, and this Korean cultural festival brings a live performance to the waterfront. It’s also a chance to shop a fantastic marketplace and indulge in Korean dishes. Insider tip: Plan to spend the whole day on the waterfront — there’s just so much to see and do.

events.title: FossilEra Open House
events.desc: While you can buy fossils and minerals online anytime from FossilEra, they only open the doors to their warehouse once a year. This epic event gives you a chance to shop a selection of fossils, minerals, crystals, stones and even meteorites in-person. Plus, there will be a geode cracker and a fossil dig pit for kids.

events.title: Lakewood SummerFest
events.loc: Fort Steilacoom Park , 8714 87th Ave. S.W., Lakewood
events.desc: If I tried to list everything happening at this epic festival, I would run out of space. Suffice to say, you can expect circus performances, a car show, tethered hot air balloon rides, fire dancing, Lego building, a petting zoo and live music. There will also be more than 30 food trucks, plus a beer garden for the grown-ups. Plan for a full day to enjoy it all!

events.title: Big Day of Play
events.loc: Rainier Playfield , 3700 S. Alaska St., Seattle
events.desc: Summer is all about two things for my family: getting outside and getting active. This amazing day of play checks off both boxes with fun games, sports and water activities. There will also be live performances and food vendors. It’s such a huge event, it spans two locations: Rainier Playfield and the Mount Baker Rowing and Sailing Center.

events.title: CHOMP!
events.loc: Marymoor Park , 6046 W. Lake Sammamish Pkwy. N.E., Redmond
events.desc: Want to have the same weekend plans as Daniel Tiger and Mikey the Rad Scientist? Look no further! They’ll both be at this annual festival that celebrates fresh, local and sustainable food. Shop the farmers market, climb a tree, meet farm animals and join a parade. Don’t miss live performances from Seattle’s own Warren Dunes and Marshall Law Band.

events.title: Back to School Touch-A-Truck at The Outlet Collection
events.loc: The Outlet Collection Seattle , 1101 Outlet Collection Way, Auburn
events.desc: Make back-to-school shopping extra fun with this free event. Kids can explore fire trucks and police cars, and get some energy out in the bounce houses. Don’t forget to spin the prize wheel!

events.title: Seattle Design Festival Block Party
events.loc: Lake Union Park , 860 Terry Ave. N., Seattle
events.desc: The 2026 Seattle Design Festival kicks off this weekend with a two-day block party. Immerse yourself in art with more than 30 large-scale installations, alongside performances, activities and workshops. This year’s theme is IN[FLUX], inviting conversations about change and uncertainty.

events.title: BrasilFest
events.loc: Seattle Center Armory , 305 Harrison St., Seattle
events.desc: The Seattle Center Festál series has been celebrating different cultures and traditions all year long, and Sunday’s fest highlights Brazilian arts, folklore and more. Try Brazilian cuisine, enjoy martial arts performances, join a dance workshop and learn something new!
